description: Synthetic-only mapping used to exercise canonical care-state reconstruction in public tests.
acute_care_return_policy: A discharged-to-emergency-or-inpatient transition within the configured follow-up window is classified with transition_type 'acute_care_return'; acute_care_return is never a care state.
unknown_policy: Unmapped or irreconcilable source records produce canonical state 'unknown' with uncertainty metadata.
